character_map.blurb: A joint expedition of communications researchers, primatologists, and mercenaries races into the Congo jungle seeking a lost diamond mine and the ruins of a forgotten city. They contend with rival factions, hostile terrain, and a species of unknown gray apes guarding the site. The novel blends techno-thriller pacing with adventure and zoological speculation.
character_map.notes: Character map based on the 1980 first-edition text. The novel blends fictional characters with real geographical and zoological detail. Amy's ultimate fate — released into the wild — is a significant thematic resolution. The gray apes are presented ambiguously as possibly a purpose-bred guardian race, a mystery not fully resolved in the text.
character_map.title: Congo

factions.label: ERTS (Earth Resources Technology Services)
factions.description: A Houston-based technology consortium that deploys rapid-response expeditions to locate strategic mineral resources.

factions.label: Euro-Japanese Consortium
factions.description: A rival corporate alliance competing to locate the same Type IIb boron-blue diamonds in the Congo.

factions.label: Academic / Scientific
factions.description: University researchers focused on primate language research and field science rather than corporate interests.

factions.label: Field Personnel & Local Guides
factions.description: Mercenaries, porters, and regional specialists who provide logistical muscle and local knowledge for the expedition.

factions.label: Gray Apes of Zinj
factions.description: An unclassified primate species that has guarded the ruins of the lost city of Zinj across generations, attacking all intruders.

character_map.subtitle: Michael Crichton, 1980

characters.name: Karen Ross
characters.description: A young, highly analytical ERTS computer expert and field director who leads the expedition with ruthless efficiency. She prioritizes the corporate mission above all other considerations.

characters.name: Peter Elliot
characters.description: A University of California researcher who has taught American Sign Language to Amy the gorilla. He joins the expedition to study the mysterious primate drawings Amy produces.

characters.name: Amy
characters.description: A lowland gorilla who communicates via sign language and an electronic vocoder. Her dreams and drawings of the lost city provide the expedition's key navigational clue; she is eventually released to live among wild gorillas.

characters.name: Charles Munro
characters.description: A seasoned and cynical African mercenary and expedition leader who manages the logistical and security demands of the journey through the Congo.

characters.name: R.B. Travis
characters.description: The head of ERTS back in Houston, who coordinates the mission remotely using satellite communications and applies constant pressure on Karen Ross to beat the rival consortium.

characters.name: Kahega
characters.description: Munro's trusted head porter and scout, who proves reliable and resourceful throughout the expedition's dangerous journey into the jungle.

characters.name: Jeffrey Hamill
characters.description: Leader of the first ERTS expedition to the Congo, whose team is wiped out near Zinj before the main story begins. His death and garbled transmissions set the entire plot in motion.

characters.name: Donald Rossiter
characters.description: A CIA operative who monitors the expedition and represents American governmental interest in the strategic diamond find, providing covert assistance and complications.

characters.name: Morikawa / Consortium Field Leader
characters.description: The leader of the Euro-Japanese consortium field team racing to reach Zinj ahead of ERTS. The rival team is ultimately destroyed by the gray apes.

characters.name: Gray Apes of Zinj
characters.description: An unclassified, possibly human-bred primate species that systematically kills all intruders entering the lost city of Zinj. They are the primary lethal threat in the novel's climax and are exterminated when the volcano destroys the site.

characters.name: Sam Maxwell
characters.description: A technical specialist on the expedition responsible for satellite uplink communications, keeping the team connected to Travis in Houston.

character_map.coverage_note: Several named porters and minor Congolese officials appear in the novel but are omitted here due to the character cap and low structural significance. The Euro-Japanese consortium field leader's precise name is uncertain; character is included at structural level only.
